title: Median of Two Sorted Arrays
kidExplanation: Story version: To find the median of two sorted arrays 'nums1' and 'nums2', we can perform a binary search on the smaller array. We partition both arrays into two parts such that the left half contains smaller elements and the right half contains larger elements. The median will be the average of the maximum element in the left half and the minimum element in the right half. We adjust the partition indices based on binary search, aiming to keep the same number of elements in both halves. (We will slow down and draw it.)
